title: Disappointing Performance Issues
body: The Done app has been helpful in the past, but lately, I’ve noticed significant delays in its response time. The app frequently lags or hangs when navigating, which disrupts the user experience. It’s disappointing to see these issues, especially now that they’re pushing users toward a premium subscription. I believe the app’s performance needs to be improved and stabilized before asking users to pay for additional features.

title: LOVE IT!
body:
I’ve been on iOS for a long time now and this is the first time I’m ever making a review. That’s how much I love the app. It keeps me accountable and I love how simple and streamlined the interface is. 

A suggestion would be to adjust the time your day starts. I’m on a shifting schedule so I have to go from day shifts to night shifts, and I keep having to go the day before in order to keep up with the tracking. This would be helpful for people who work nights as well.
